tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma la brten pa'i gnod

sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma la brten pa'i gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ shing leb la sku 'dra bya/ rab gnas grub nas/ rang bdag bskyed bsgom la nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i/ baṃ yaṃ brtsegs pa las nor rgyun ma ser mo/ phyag g.yas kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gos dang*/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa/ skra 'khyil ba/ rgyan dang na bza' rdzogs pa/ gser gyi brag skyibs na byang chub shing la rgyab brten pa/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pas gnod sbyin mo bkug nas bstim/ dbang bskur nas gshin rje gshed kyis dbu brgyan/ rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya skye gnas su reg la/ oṃ yo yakṣi ṇi bī ra dze swāhā/ zhes bzlas la mchod pa 'bul/ de gos kyi sa g.yogs la bzhag /sngags 'bum phrag bcus 'grub ste bsnyen pa'o/ / gsung 'di yang tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gsum la sbyar ba'o// // shumbha ma stu// bkra shis// PAGE PAGE - PAGE 1 -
